mapper.select: select o.workspace_id, o.outbox_id, o.event_id, e.event_seq, e.event_type, e.payload_json, e.correlation_id, o.consumer, o.outbox_state, o.attempts, o.claim_token, o.claimed_until from aden_outbox o join aden_event e on e.workspace_id = o.workspace_id and e.event_id = o.event_id where (o.outbox_state = 'PENDING' and o.available_at <= #{now}) or (o.outbox_state = 'CLAIMED' and o.claimed_until <= #{now}) order by o.available_at, o.workspace_id, o.outbox_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked

select o.workspace_id, o.outbox_id, o.event_id, e.event_seq, e.event_type, e.payload_json, e.correlation_id, o.consumer, o.outbox_state, o.attempts, o.claim_token, o.claimed_until from aden_outbox o join aden_event e on e.workspace_id = o.workspace_id and e.event_id = o.event_id where o.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} and o.outbox_id = #{outboxId} and o.outbox_state = 'CLAIMED' and o.claim_token = #{claimToken}
